skill.name: vision
skill.description: Analyze images, screenshots, diagrams, UI mockups, and other visual content with concise observations.
skill.summary: Interprets screenshots, diagrams, UI mockups, and visual content with actionable observations.
skill.author: 0xSero

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, executable code, filesystem access, network access, or credential handling. No remediation is required for publication from this audit.

content.value_statement: Visual files can hide errors, layout issues, and important text. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code inspect screenshots, diagrams, and mockups with concise observations.
actual_capabilities: Describe visible UI elements, text, errors, code, layouts, and diagrams.
Extract legible text accurately while preserving useful formatting.
Flag broken, inconsistent, or suspicious visual details.
State uncertainty when a visual reading has low confidence.
Provide concise observations for screenshots, diagrams, and mockups.
limitations: Requires an image or clear visual reference to analyze.
Cannot inspect hidden UI states that are not visible in the image.
Text extraction accuracy depends on image resolution and clarity.
Does not execute applications or validate source code by itself.

use_cases.title: Review UI Mockups
use_cases.description: Inspect mockups for visible layout issues, unclear labels, missing states, and inconsistent visual details.

use_cases.title: Triage Error Screenshots
use_cases.description: Read error screenshots, identify visible messages, and summarize likely problem areas for follow-up.

use_cases.title: Interpret Technical Diagrams
use_cases.description: Describe diagram components, relationships, labels, and unclear areas so teams can discuss them faster.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze This Screenshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the attached screenshot. Describe the visible UI, extract readable text, and list anything broken or suspicious.

prompt_templates.title: Review a UI Mockup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the attached UI mockup for layout problems, missing states, unclear labels, and inconsistencies. Return prioritized observations.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret a Diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the attached architecture or process diagram. Identify components, relationships, labels, and unclear areas. Note any assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Visual States
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the attached before and after screenshots. Identify layout changes, text changes, regressions, and uncertain readings.

output_examples.input: Screenshot of an account settings page with an error banner.
output_examples.output: The page shows account settings with profile fields and a red save error. The error text is readable. The save button appears disabled, which may block recovery.

output_examples.input: Architecture diagram with three connected service boxes.
output_examples.output: The diagram shows a client sending requests to an API service, which writes to a database and calls a worker. The worker label is partially unclear.

output_examples.input: Mobile checkout mockup with form fields and a payment button.
output_examples.output: The checkout form has visible fields for name, address, and card details. The payment button is prominent, but the terms text is small and difficult to read.

best_practices: Attach the highest-resolution image available for better text extraction.
Ask for specific checks, such as layout, text, errors, or diagram relationships.
Request uncertainty notes when visual details are small or partially hidden.
anti_patterns: Do not expect accurate analysis of content outside the visible image.
Do not use low-quality screenshots when exact text matters.
Do not treat visual observations as proof that software behavior is correct.

faq.question: What types of images can this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It can analyze screenshots, UI mockups, diagrams, error images, and other visual content.

faq.question: Can it extract text from an image?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract legible text and preserve formatting when that helps the task.

faq.question: Does it run code or open applications?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes visible image content and does not execute applications or source code.

faq.question: Can it find UI problems?
faq.answer: Yes. It can flag visible layout issues, unclear labels, broken states, and inconsistent details.

faq.question: How should I prompt it for best results?
faq.answer: Attach a clear image and specify whether you need text extraction, issue review, or diagram interpretation.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
